(() => { const i = document.querySelector('input'); if (!i) throw new Error('search input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(i, '编程'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '搜索'); b.click(); return 'ok' })()
smoke.note: 受控 input 必须用原生 setter 再派发 input 事件，直接改 .value 不会触发 React 的 onChange
